integrity: Each optimum is a complete reverse-complement-orbit clique; explicit word-level overlap constraints, two distinct exhaustive enumerators and a length-12 witness are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite census only at binary lengths 1..12; not an all-length capacity formula, not physical DNA error correction. Publication priority has not been independently audited.
title: Sharp short-block capacities and extremizer census for reverse-complement-closed binary non-overlapping codes
